questions.prompt: A straight-chain hydrocarbon with at most one multiple bond and the molecular formula C₄H₁₀ belongs to the ____ family.
questions.explanation: C₄H₁₀ with n = 4 fits CₙH₂ₙ₊₂: alkane.

questions.prompt: A straight-chain hydrocarbon with at most one multiple bond and the molecular formula C₄H₆ belongs to the ____ family.
questions.explanation: C₄H₆ with n = 4 fits CₙH₂ₙ₋₂: alkyne.

questions.prompt: A straight-chain hydrocarbon with at most one multiple bond and the molecular formula C₆H₁₄ belongs to the ____ family.
questions.explanation: C₆H₁₄ with n = 6 fits CₙH₂ₙ₊₂: alkane.

questions.prompt: A compound with the same molecular formula as butyl methanoate but a different structure is ____.
questions.explanation: Butyl methanoate and pentanoic acid are both C₅H₁₀O₂ but have different structures.

questions.prompt: CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₂OH is correctly named ____.
questions.explanation: Number from the –OH end so that –OH gets the smaller number: butan-1-ol, not butan-4-ol.

questions.prompt: The displayed formula of nonane has ____ C–H bonds.
questions.explanation: Each hydrogen forms one C–H bond: 20 hydrogens = 20 C–H bonds.

questions.prompt: A straight-chain hydrocarbon with at most one multiple bond and the molecular formula C₈H₁₄ belongs to the ____ family.
questions.explanation: C₈H₁₄ with n = 8 fits CₙH₂ₙ₋₂: alkyne.

questions.prompt: CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₂CH₂OH is correctly named ____.
questions.explanation: Number from the –OH end so that –OH gets the smaller number: pentan-1-ol, not pentan-5-ol.

questions.prompt: The displayed formula of decane has ____ C–H bonds.
questions.explanation: Each hydrogen forms one C–H bond: 22 hydrogens = 22 C–H bonds.

questions.prompt: The displayed formula of pentane has ____ C–C bonds.
questions.explanation: 5 carbons in a row are joined by 4 C–C bonds.

questions.prompt: The displayed formula of butane has ____ C–H bonds.
questions.explanation: Each hydrogen forms one C–H bond: 10 hydrogens = 10 C–H bonds.

questions.prompt: The displayed formula of nonane has ____ C–C bonds.
questions.explanation: 9 carbons in a row are joined by 8 C–C bonds.

questions.prompt: The displayed formula of methane has ____ C–H bonds.
questions.explanation: Each hydrogen forms one C–H bond: 4 hydrogens = 4 C–H bonds.

questions.prompt: A straight-chain hydrocarbon with at most one multiple bond and the molecular formula C₃H₄ belongs to the ____ family.
questions.explanation: C₃H₄ with n = 3 fits CₙH₂ₙ₋₂: alkyne.

questions.prompt: The displayed formula of octane has ____ C–C bonds.
questions.explanation: 8 carbons in a row are joined by 7 C–C bonds.
